cf_med: §2.6.1 Conventions global attribute does not contain "CF-1.11"

Variable ta850 has a temperature related standard_name and it is recommended that the units_metadata attribute is present and has one of the values ['temperature: difference', 'temperature: on_scale', 'temperature: unknown']

Variable time has a calendar attribute of standard and it is recommended that the units_metadata attribute is present and has one of the values ['leap_seconds: none', 'leap_seconds: utc', 'leap_seconds: unknown']
cc6_med: It is recommended that data should be compressed with a 'deflate level' of '1' and enabled 'shuffle' option. The data is uncompressed. The 'shuffle' option is disabled.
It is recommended for the variables 'rlat' and 'rlon' or 'x' and 'y' to have bounds defined.
It is recommended for the variables 'lat' and 'lon' to have bounds defined.
The global attribute 'driving_source' is not defined. It is however recommended to include it.

The global attribute 'version_realization_info' is missing. It is however recommended, if 'version_realization' deviates from 'v1-r1'. The attribute 'version_realization_info' provides information on how reruns (eg. v2, v3) and/or realizations (eg. r2, r3) are generated.

cc6_med: It is recommended that data should be compressed with a 'deflate level' of '1' and enabled 'shuffle' option. The data is uncompressed. The 'shuffle' option is disabled.

The first timestep differs from expectation ('1980-01-01 12:00:00'): '1980-01-01 09:00:00'. Apart from the first and last files of a timeseries '5' full simulation years are expected in the data file for frequency 'day'.

The last timestep differs from expectation ('1980-12-31 12:00:00'): '1980-12-31 09:00:00'. Apart from the first and last files of a timeseries '5' full simulation years are expected in the data file for frequency 'day'.
It is recommended for the variables 'rlat' and 'rlon' or 'x' and 'y' to have bounds defined.
It is recommended for the variables 'lat' and 'lon' to have bounds defined.
The global attribute 'driving_source' is not defined. It is however recommended to include it.

The global attribute 'version_realization_info' is missing. It is however recommended, if 'version_realization' deviates from 'v1-r1'. The attribute 'version_realization_info' provides information on how reruns (eg. v2, v3) and/or realizations (eg. r2, r3) are generated.
